Philosophy.label: Thought Architecture
Philosophy.title: Personal Framework
Philosophy.pillar_1_desc: Developing systems that don't just withstand, but benefit and scale from chaos and volatility.
Philosophy.pillar_1_c2: Error tolerance: Exposing oneself to small risks that generate massive learnings, without risk of total ruin.
Philosophy.pillar_1_c3: Continuous adaptation: Recalibrate path instantly, leveraging stress to grow stronger.
Philosophy.pillar_2_desc: Aggressive competence acquisition driven by 'Build to Learn' ideology to dissolve operational bottlenecks.
Philosophy.pillar_2_c2: Build to learn: Prioritize immediate construction as the ultimate vehicle for knowledge retention.
Philosophy.pillar_2_c3: Directness: Learn operating directly in the real-world environment where the skill is demanded.
Philosophy.product_desc: The operational synthesis. A proprietary framework that refracts raw complexity into high-traction, auditable components.
Philosophy.pillar_1_sub_1_desc: Intentional small doses of volatility injected to prevent concealed weaknesses and force active system evolution.
Philosophy.pillar_1_sub_2_desc: Capability to capture positive asymmetric opportunities with minimal risk, securing modular bypass operational paths.
Philosophy.pillar_1_sub_3_desc: Coupling ultra-safe guarantees (90%) with aggressive localized risk (10%), mathematically expunging total ruin risk.
Philosophy.pillar_2_sub_1_desc: Knowledge architecture mapping. Deconstructing the skill and decoding its logical skeleton prior to active implementation.
Philosophy.pillar_2_sub_2_desc: High-intensity targeted exercise. Isolating and neutralizing the weakest performance bottleneck for rapid marginal growth.
Philosophy.pillar_2_sub_3_desc: Active recall and spaced repetition protocols that permanently crystallize data against cognitive degradation.
Philosophy.practice_desc: Coming soon: Projects and deliverables that instantiate these technical blueprints.
Philosophy.prisma_p_desc: Identify true value for the client or institution, setting the direction.
Philosophy.prisma_r_desc: Determine which risks to assume and mitigate them strategically.
Philosophy.prisma_i_desc: Which tools to leverage and how to extract maximum tech synergy.
Philosophy.prisma_s_desc: Vital indicators measuring the business and securing its stability.
Philosophy.prisma_m_desc: The tactical path to transform vision into execution and outcomes.
Philosophy.prisma_a_desc: A stance that not only survives stress but learns and thrives from it.

Timeline.node_product_content: End-to-end Product Lifecycle, lean methodologies, and supply chain scaling (KQ Universitários / Avolta Group).
Timeline.node_engineering_content: Civil Engineering rigor meets Industrial Automation execution. Building robust, predictable systems.
Timeline.node_design_content: Systemic Thinking, Service Design, Technical Design Leadership, UX and Design for Scalability.
Timeline.node_code_content: Solving Real Friction: Development of proprietary ERPs in Python for P&L and logistics control, as well as advanced RPA scripts integrating complex production flows.
Timeline.node_founder_content: Full systems vision. Decision making under high pressure and P&L management calibrated for structural independence (Successful Exit after 10 years).
Timeline.node_pm_content: Project Delivery & Operations: Leading complex launches, Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), and operational excellence in multinational environments.

Timeline_Dossier.title: Curriculum Vitae
Timeline_Dossier.item1_desc: Opened the group's 1st restaurant in Latin America (US$15.8B global revenue). Acted as Supply Chain Buyer, bridge between international stakeholders and local operations, and Product Owner of the 'Digital' software — integrating Brazil's fiscal complexity into Avolta's global Oracle Inventory Management system.
Timeline_Dossier.item2_desc: Founded and scaled a national custom manufacturing operation (+12 product lines). Built a system that ran autonomously for 12 months during the Ireland transition. Sold as a fully operational asset — proof of systemic antifragility.
Timeline_Dossier.item3_desc: Developed Python RPA automations for UFJF's Infrastructure Department. The project was expanded by other students to multiple departments after the internship ended — direct validation of the initial architecture's robustness.
Timeline_Dossier.item4_desc: Civil Engineering degree pursued in parallel with founding and growing KQ. Structural logic, systems thinking and engineering rigor applied to business management from day one.
Timeline_Dossier.item5_desc: Process standardization, production documentation and quality control in a high-throughput industrial environment. Practical foundation for managing complex operations.
Timeline_Dossier.item6_desc: Technical training in Industrial Automation. Focus on control logic, redundant systems, and process architecture that eliminates the need for constant supervision.
Timeline_Dossier.item0_desc: Leading product strategy to increase real estate asset value. Managing contracts between landowners, builders, and investors. Structuring data-driven offers based on real market value and asset lifecycle intelligence.

ProjectCase.context_desc: Consultancy and software development aimed at expunging reliance on fragmented communications and automating decision flow in high-pressure environments.
ProjectCase.antifragility_desc: Modules engineered under the heuristics of Nassim Taleb: systems that absorb shocks, eliminate ruin, and derive strength from pressure.
ProjectCase.stack_desc: Scalable foundation comprised of Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, NextAuth, and Object Storage (R2/S3), orchestrated in a Multi-tenant SaaS via Docker.
ProjectCase.prisma_section_desc: Analyzing the project through the Prism lens: the core method applied to ensure every logic block yields correct operational decision-making.
ProjectCase.prisma_p_desc: Core mission: lowering administrative noise to liberate strategic headspace for execution.
ProjectCase.prisma_r_desc: Mitigating administrative disorder and reducing exposure to critical deadline failure.
ProjectCase.prisma_i_desc: Unifying tools into a single source of truth, synchronizing case data and priorities.
ProjectCase.prisma_s_desc: Assuring systemic survivability at scale, minimizing the ratio of supervisors needed per process iteration.
ProjectCase.prisma_m_desc: Transparency auditing: a mathematically robust mapping of workflows from task ingress to revenue delivery.
ProjectCase.p1_desc: Replacement of emotional bias with Prioritization Engineering (Score = 4×Importance + 2×Urgency + Difficulty). Every idle day injects +0.1 pts, weaponizing time to force efficiency.
ProjectCase.p2_desc: Reduced personnel bottlenecks. Empowering the operation to execute regardless of key vacancies.
ProjectCase.p3_desc: Eliminated the core fragility vector: anyone losing a task. The system is engineered to purely reveal exactly which task demands focus right now.
ProjectCase.p4_desc: Decisional independence through 'Complete Cutout' dashboards for immediate execution. Converting raw friction into organized, auditable intellectual equity.
ProjectCase.p5_desc: Engineered loop where increased case volume directly feeds back into the statistical engine. More work iterates into superior mathematical precision under stress.
ProjectCase.puzzle_chess_desc: In Puzzle Chess, all information resides directly on the board. You only need to execute the best next decision — and trust the system to return focus ONLY to items requiring it. This unshackles total team memory.
ProjectCase.clarity_desc: Instituted a clear rating for importance, urgency, and value to minimize emotional bias. Mathematical logic handles ordering.
ProjectCase.deadlines_desc: Progressive score escalation tied to aging and case stage. This forces resolution on stalled artifacts and accelerates case cycle time.
ProjectCase.ul_1_desc: Total immersion into the user cycle, identifying latent friction points not visible from a surface-level operational view.
ProjectCase.ul_2_desc: Exhaustive market survey concluding that zero off-the-shelf solutions handled strict prioritization natively (the core structural fragility), validating the custom build.
ProjectCase.ul_3_desc: High-velocity iterations with zero-latency feedback loops, converting direct employee input into hyper-specialized specialized code deliverables.

ProjectCaseNH.context_desc: Digital presence overhaul and visual identity to match online image with the operational weight of the company. Solving historic dependence on IT for basic updates.
ProjectCaseNH.main_pillar_desc: Development focused on eradicating human bottlenecks through assisted technology and consistent premium design.
ProjectCaseNH.stack_desc: High-performance SPA architecture based on Vite and React, styled with TailwindCSS, hosted on self-managed infrastructure on Hetzner Cloud via Cloudflare CDN.
ProjectCaseNH.prisma_section_desc: Strategic refactoring of digital footprint through the PRISMA lens, synchronizing visual perception with corporate capability.
ProjectCaseNH.prisma_p_desc: Elevate digital visibility to operational scale, projecting security and reliability to high-tier industrial partners.
ProjectCaseNH.prisma_r_desc: Neutralizing legacy software lock-in risks and platform dependency by seizing absolute infrastructure sovereignty.
ProjectCaseNH.prisma_i_desc: Seamless dynamic synchronization of static assets (Cloudinary) and dynamic content registries (Markdown dynamic loaders).
ProjectCaseNH.prisma_s_desc: Ensuring survival via manager autonomy: CMS independence guaranteeing content relevance even without tech intervention.
ProjectCaseNH.prisma_m_desc: Formalized Playbook architecture, strictly paving consistency paths for next-phase digital scale.
ProjectCaseNH.antifragility_desc: Mechanisms engineered to absorb daily editing frictions, deriving structural agility from distributed management.
ProjectCaseNH.p1_desc: Key differentiator: integrated system allowing the client to add projects, partners and timeline milestones with zero IT dependency. No more operational bottlenecks.
ProjectCaseNH.p2_desc: Institutionalization of proprietary vocabulary (PRISMA) and the Obvious Yes Principle, solidifying intangible brand equity.
ProjectCaseNH.p3_desc: Efficient use of 'wouter' and localized state stores ensuring near-instant load speed without the weight of legacy bloated frameworks.
ProjectCaseNH.p4_desc: Migration from PaaS Render to custom Ubuntu nodes on Hetzner (via Docker/Caddy), drastically reducing latency while gaining total control of DNS & SSL.
ProjectCaseNH.p5_desc: Establishment of behavioral directives conveying corporate safety, certainty of returns and strict analytical clarity.
ProjectCaseNH.footnote_title: Aligning physical delivery with digital perception.
ProjectCaseNH.footnote_desc: Operational autonomy removed technical dependency friction, directly mirroring business agility in the public interface.

ProjectCaseSB.context_desc: Developing an autonomous 'Second Brain' grounded in the 'File over App' philosophy. Born from the need for continuous improvement and seamless communication between tools in the age of AI and became a lifestyle.
ProjectCaseSB.main_pillar_desc: Strictly separated architecture across Memory (Obsidian), Logic (Agno), and Execution (Antigravity).
ProjectCaseSB.stack_desc: Dockerized orchestration deployed to a Hetzner VPS, establishing persistence via RClone daemons, semantic embeddings via Graphify, and agentic pipeline handling in Python.
ProjectCaseSB.prisma_section_desc: The backbone of external memory: guarding knowledge flow against latent fragmentation and decay.
ProjectCaseSB.prisma_p_desc: Deliver absolute universal context continuity. Constructing an external lobe storing complex logics between temporal gaps.
ProjectCaseSB.prisma_r_desc: Defending from transient memory loss and critical insight leakages via a hard-coupled Always-On capture routine.
ProjectCaseSB.prisma_i_desc: Constructing the tool-agnostic bridge coupling markdown libraries, vector lakes (RAG), and model orchestration layer.
ProjectCaseSB.prisma_s_desc: 'File over App' ideology. Sovereign knowledge persistence designed to sustain functional lifecycles spanning decades.
ProjectCaseSB.prisma_m_desc: A multi-phase roadmap that started as a simple note-storage system and evolved into a self-orchestrated harness. Today it documents wikis, structures learnings, and enforces conformity across AI tools — Gemini, Claude, Antigravity — all running the same operational harness.
ProjectCaseSB.antifragility_desc: A systemic brain storing value logarithmically, expanding density in inverse proportion to surrounding noise.
ProjectCaseSB.p1_desc: Abolition of rigid hierarchies. Flow driven by YAML metadata and Graph Wikilinks, forcing the organic emergence of non-linear ideas. The system improves with use.
ProjectCaseSB.p2_desc: Agents that process everything done during the day — via GitHub commits and Obsidian note changes — and update the living notes selected by the user. Knowledge is always current.
ProjectCaseSB.p3_desc: A dynamic switching engine between AI models that does not lock us into a single CLI or agent like Claude Code. The same harness runs behind Gemini, Antigravity and Claude — the structure is always in control.
ProjectCaseSB.p4_desc: The more direction the harness provides, the less AI hallucinates and the fewer tokens are consumed. It is a system for using AI without anxiously waiting for whatever it produces — precision over probability.
ProjectCaseSB.p5_desc: Antigravity interacts natively via IDE/Browser in Strict Mode, allowing the ecosystem to dynamically iterate on its own source code safely.
ProjectCaseSB.ul_1_desc: Originated as a knowledge management and RAG case study during the consulting project with Siqueira e Vale.
ProjectCaseSB.ul_2_desc: Transformed into a heavily self-tested personal project before extending deployment to end clients.
ProjectCaseSB.ul_3_desc: Accelerated mastery through rapid applied creation. The fastest path to truly understanding RAG is full-tilt execution.
ProjectCaseSB.fase2: Phase 2: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration beyond the second brain · In Progress
ProjectCaseSB.footnote_title: Do it well once and avoid rework.
ProjectCaseSB.footnote_desc: This portfolio is a success story. The Second Brain is the source of truth.

ProjectCaseHC.context_desc: Transforming the traditional friction of gathering honeymoon funds into a competitive, fun and highly engaging social experience for wedding guests.
ProjectCaseHC.main_pillar_desc: Living proof that creative execution (Build to Learn) beats dusty ideas. Developed at light speed to stress-test the viability of interactive social logic.
ProjectCaseHC.stack_desc: Ultra-lightweight Single Page Application optimized for real-time traffic bursts from QR Codes during the reception. Optimized for instant visual feedback.
ProjectCaseHC.prisma_section_desc: Transforming a celebratory event into a gamified operational framework via direct feedback loops.
ProjectCaseHC.prisma_p_desc: Maximizing guest interaction and fundraising efficiency through high-leverage playful competition.
ProjectCaseHC.prisma_r_desc: Mitigating gifting friction and potential boredom, ensuring users felt immediate participatory value.
ProjectCaseHC.prisma_i_desc: Direct binding of entry payment QR triggers to live numerical scoreboard manipulation.
ProjectCaseHC.prisma_s_desc: Guaranteed crash-resiliency under extreme single-night bursts from heavy concurrent mobile traffic.
ProjectCaseHC.prisma_m_desc: The definitive competitive map: Real-time Versus Leaderboard visualized globally.
ProjectCaseHC.antifragility_desc: A prototype that derived exponential strength from chaotic real-world use during live party execution.
ProjectCaseHC.p1_desc: Direct clash: Italy (Matheus) vs Croatia/Iceland (Taís). The bias of 'disagreement' drove extreme engagement, with couples paying twice to flip the board.
ProjectCaseHC.p2_desc: $1 Contributed = 1 Point. A direct parity math system driving a powerful dopamine loop during the party, tracking the clear winner live.
ProjectCaseHC.p3_desc: The actual identity catalyst of 'Build to Learn'. An instinct-driven AI project yielding a real-world return 4x past initial financial ceilings.
ProjectCaseHC.p4_desc: Reinforced the supreme corporate directive: stop over-polishing the asset. My wife's order to ship it 'as-is' precisely validated the viable MVP.
ProjectCaseHC.p5_desc: Ultralearning ultimate takeaway: having something imperfect currently functioning crushes the illusion of the perfect idea stuck in a drawer.
